select * from ( select c.id, c.schedule_Date as scheduleDate, mi.machine_name as codeId, c.spec_desc as innerMsg, c.SAP_CODE as cpdh, c.embryo_code as specdh, (case when CLASS1_START_TIME is null then (case when CLASS2_START_TIME is null then CLASS3_START_TIME else CLASS2_START_TIME end) else CLASS1_START_TIME end ) as startDate, (case when CLASS3_END_TIME is null then (case when CLASS2_END_TIME is null then CLASS1_END_TIME else CLASS2_END_TIME end) else CLASS3_END_TIME end ) as endDate, NVL(class1_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class2_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class3_plan_qty, 0) as ydl, NVL(fq.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, 0)+NVL(fq.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, 0)+NVL(fq.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, 0) as ywcl from T_LH_SCHEDULE_RESULT c left join T_LH_MACHINE_INFO mi on mi.DEL_FLAG='0' and c.LH_MACHINE_CODE=mi.MACHINE_CODE left join T_LH_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY fq on fq.ORDER_NO=c.ORDER_NO and fq.del_flag='0' where 1=1 and c.DEL_FLAG='0' and c.spec_desc is not null and c.embryo_code is not null and c.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) where startDate is not null and endDate is not null and ydl>0 order by codeId,startDate

select min(scheduleDate) as scheduleDate, codeId, min(startDate) as startDate, max(endDate) as endDate, innerMsg, cpdh, specdh, sum(ydl) as ydl, sum(ywcl) as ywcl from ( select c.schedule_Date as scheduleDate, c.spec_desc as codeId, (case when CLASS1_START_TIME is null then (case when CLASS2_START_TIME is null then CLASS3_START_TIME else CLASS2_START_TIME end) else CLASS1_START_TIME end ) as startDate, (case when CLASS3_END_TIME is null then (case when CLASS2_END_TIME is null then CLASS1_END_TIME else CLASS2_END_TIME end) else CLASS3_END_TIME end ) as endDate, c.spec_desc as innerMsg, c.SAP_CODE as cpdh, c.embryo_code as specdh, NVL(class1_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class2_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class3_plan_qty, 0) as ydl, NVL(fq.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, 0)+NVL(fq.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, 0)+NVL(fq.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, 0) as ywcl from T_LH_SCHEDULE_RESULT c left join T_LH_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY fq on fq.ORDER_NO=c.ORDER_NO and fq.del_flag='0' where 1=1 and c.DEL_FLAG='0' and c.spec_desc is not null and c.embryo_code is not null and c.schedule_date <= to_date(#{endDay,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') and c.schedule_date >= to_date(#{startDay,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-mm-dd') ) where startDate is not null and endDate is not null and ydl>0 group by codeId,innerMsg,cpdh,specdh order by scheduleDate
